note: Started at task 3.4 (baselines + LLM client). Real intent-model metrics (macro-F1, per-class recall, ECE, confusion matrix, es/pt breakdown) are filled in at tasks 3.5/3.6 from the offline training run; this file currently records the model/dependency decisions only.

embedding_model.reason: Weights are not committed (repo stays small; redistribution terms). The id+revision are pinned here; the encoder downloads and caches on the first offline run (tasks 3.5/3.6). Tests use a seeded hash StubEncoder under CORA_NLU_STUB=1.

language_id_model.fallback: lingua-language-detector==2.0.2 (pure Python) if no fasttext wheel installs

llm.fail_closed: unconfigured or erroring after bounded tenacity retry raises LLMUnavailable; no silent model-id fallback (that is a Phase-5 concern)

dependencies_nlu_group.justification: LogReg + CalibratedClassifierCV + TF-IDF; the only ML dep needed
multilingual MiniLM encoder; makes PT work with no PT training data
sentence-transformers backend, CPU build (host ~4 GB RAM)
prebuilt fastText lid.176; avoids the C++ build the fasttext sdist needs
version ST/sklearn/torch 2.4 agree on; avoids the numpy-2 ABI split
bounded retry for the Bedrock Converse call (tech steering mandates tenacity for retries)

baseline_results.note: Offline measurement over the full committed gold set (480 rows, es+pt), task 3.4. These are the numbers the learned classifier (3.5) must beat; the leakage-safe-split version is reported in intent_model.md at 3.6. B-zs (zero-shot) is reported as skipped here because Bedrock is unconfigured in the sandbox (CORA_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID empty) and B-zs fails closed rather than guessing.
baseline_results.zero_shot: skipped (no CORA_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID in the sandbox; B-zs fails closed to OTHER)

dependency_resolution: uv add --group nlu ...; uv lock verified (84 packages); uv sync --group nlu installs and imports clean on Windows / Python 3.12.10. fasttext-wheel==0.9.2 installed from a prebuilt cp312 wheel, so the lingua fallback was NOT needed.

prompts.note: Prompt SHA-256 hashes are recorded in traces at Phase 5 (structure steering).
